title: 实验室里的安全设备（国内版）
source_doc: course/Lab Safety Training Series/06_Safety Equipment Lab Safety Video Part 2.md
author_source: project/Lab Safety Training Series/06_Safety Equipment Lab Safety Video Part 2（国内版）/src.py

points.K4: 喷淋和洗眼器要定期测试
points.K10: 液体火、电气火不能用水

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室墙边，身旁是洗眼器、紧急喷淋和灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands by a lab wall next to an eyewash station, an emergency shower and a red fire extinguisher, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课认识实验室里的安全设备。

shots.scene: 喷淋、洗眼器、灭火器、灭火毯、急救箱五个图标
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: an emergency shower, an eyewash station, a fire extinguisher, a fire blanket and a first aid kit. No people.
shots.narration: 关键时刻，它们能救命。

shots.scene: 阿杰第一天来实验室，背着手四处张望
shots.prompt_en: The young male student arrives at a new lab on his first day and looks around curiously.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一天来新实验室。

shots.scene: 小研带着阿杰沿墙走，指着洗眼器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks the young male student along the lab wall and points at an eyewash station.
shots.narration: 小研说：先别忙做实验，跟我认认设备。

shots.scene: 一只烧杯从台边掉落摔碎的图标，旁边一个问号
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a beaker falling off a bench edge and breaking, with a question mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 事故难免，懂安全知识就能少出事。

shots.scene: 安全设备图标围成一圈，中间是一颗心形图标
shots.prompt_en: Safety equipment icons arranged in a circle around a heart icon. No people.
shots.narration: 万一出事，安全设备能救命。

shots.scene: 阿杰在空白平面图上依次标出设备位置
shots.prompt_en: The young male student marks the locations of safety equipment on a blank floor plan with small icons.
shots.narration: 进新实验室，先找到每件安全设备。

shots.section_title: 喷淋和洗眼器要定期测试
shots.scene: 墙上的安全淋浴标志和洗眼器标志，下面是对应设备
shots.prompt_en: An emergency shower sign and an eyewash sign on the wall above a pull-handle safety shower and an eyewash station. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室要配紧急喷淋和洗眼器。
overlay: 喷淋和洗眼器要定期测试

shots.section_title: 喷淋和洗眼器要定期测试
shots.scene: 老李拉下喷淋拉杆放水，水流进接水桶
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pulls the shower handle to test it; water flows into a bucket placed below.
shots.narration: 定期放水测试并记录，确认出水干净。

shots.scene: 液体溅向阿杰手臂的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a chemical splash hitting a person's arm and chest. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品溅到身上，或者衣服着了火，

shots.scene: 阿杰大声呼救，快步冲向紧急喷淋
shots.prompt_en: The young male student shouts for help and hurries to the nearest emergency shower.
shots.narration: 大声呼救，立刻冲到最近的喷淋下。

shots.scene: 阿杰在喷淋下，拉起喷淋帘，脱下浸湿的实验服
shots.prompt_en: Under the running emergency shower, the young male student pulls a privacy curtain and takes off his soaked lab coat.
shots.narration: 脱掉被浸透的衣物，

shots.scene: 水流冲洗手臂皮肤的特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of shower water rinsing a forearm thoroughly. No people.
shots.narration: 在喷淋下把沾到的皮肤彻底冲干净。

shots.scene: 衣服着火的人站到喷淋下全身淋湿的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person with flames on clothing standing under a shower, water covering the whole body. No people.
shots.narration: 身上着火，就让全身都淋湿。

shots.scene: 小研一边帮忙一边拿手机拨号，屏幕空白
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student calls for help on a mobile phone with a blank screen while staying near the shower.
shots.narration: 请旁边的人拨打急救电话。

shots.scene: 小研扶着阿杰走到洗眼器前
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student guides the young male student, who covers one eye, to the eyewash station.
shots.narration: 化学品进了眼睛，马上用洗眼器。

shots.scene: 阿杰俯身，用手指撑开眼睑，两股水流冲向眼睛
shots.prompt_en: The young male student bends over the eyewash station and holds his eyelids open with his fingers as two water jets rinse his eyes.
shots.narration: 用手指撑开眼睑，让水冲进眼睛。

shots.scene: 沙漏图标旁边，水流不断
shots.prompt_en: An hourglass icon next to the running eyewash water jets. No people.
shots.narration: 持续冲洗足够长时间，再去就医。

shots.scene: 木头、纸张、布料燃烧的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of burning wood, paper and cloth. No people.
shots.narration: 原片第一类：木头、纸、布等着火，

shots.scene: 水桶和灭火器图标打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a water bucket and a fire extinguisher with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 可以用水或通用灭火器扑救。

shots.section_title: 液体火、电气火不能用水
shots.scene: 溶剂瓶起火、插座冒火花两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a solvent bottle on fire and an electrical socket with sparks. No people.
shots.narration: 溶剂、易燃液体着火，电器着火，
overlay: 液体火、电气火不能用水

shots.section_title: 液体火、电气火不能用水
shots.scene: 往着火的溶剂和插座上泼水的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of water being thrown on a burning solvent and a sparking socket, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 千万别泼水，火会蔓延，还可能触电。

shots.scene: 一小块金属燃烧的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a small piece of burning metal with a dim glow. No people.
shots.narration: 活泼金属着火，实验室里比较少见。

shots.scene: 出口门旁墙上挂着灭火器，上方有灭火器标志
shots.prompt_en: A fire extinguisher hangs on the wall beside the lab exit door, under a fire extinguisher sign. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室多配干粉灭火器，就放在出口旁。

shots.scene: 干粉灭火器旁三个火灾图标都打勾
shots.prompt_en: A dry powder fire extinguisher icon with three fire type icons beside it, all with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 它能扑救多种常见的初起火灾。

shots.scene: 火势变大的图标，旁边一个向外的箭头
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a growing fire with a large arrow pointing toward an exit door. No people.
shots.narration: 火太大，扑不灭，

shots.scene: 小研招呼大家撤离，阿杰跟着跑向安全出口
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student waves everyone out, and the young male student follows her toward an emergency exit sign.
shots.narration: 马上让所有人撤离，并拨打119。

shots.scene: 王老师在室外空地上给学生讲解灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator explains a fire extinguisher to a group of students on an open training yard.
shots.narration: 灭火器要先经过消防培训才会用。

shots.scene: 小研从墙上的盒子里拉出灭火毯
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pulls a fire blanket out of its wall-mounted pouch by the two tabs.
shots.narration: 灭火毯能盖灭小火，也能救衣服着火的人。

shots.scene: 站着的人被毯子裹住、火焰向上的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a standing person wrapped in a blanket with flames rising toward the head, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别让人站着裹毯子，火会往头上窜。

shots.scene: 躺倒、裹住、翻滚三个步骤图标
shots.prompt_en: Three step icons: a person lying down, a person wrapped in a blanket on the floor, and the wrapped person rolling. No people.
shots.narration: 扶他躺倒，裹住，帮他翻滚到火灭。

shots.scene: 小研打开墙上急救箱，里面是绷带和消毒用品
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a wall-mounted first aid kit showing bandages and antiseptic packs with blank labels.
shots.narration: 急救箱里有绷带和消毒用品，处理小伤。

shots.scene: 门旁墙上一张空白平面图，几条箭头通向两个出口
shots.prompt_en: A blank evacuation floor plan on the wall by the door, with arrows leading to two different emergency exits. No people.
shots.narration: 出口附近贴着疏散路线图。

shots.scene: 一条路线被障碍挡住，另一条路线亮起绿色
shots.prompt_en: On the floor plan icon, one route is blocked by a barrier and another route lights up green. No people.
shots.narration: 多记几条路线，一条堵了走另一条。

shots.scene: 小研在化学通风柜里操作，蒸汽被吸走
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works inside a chemical fume hood; vapor from a beaker is drawn up and away.
shots.narration: 通风柜把有毒蒸气抽走，保护你的呼吸。

shots.scene: 手指按下通风柜的排风开关
shots.prompt_en: A finger presses the exhaust fan switch on a fume hood panel with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 先开排风，看风速指示是否正常。

shots.scene: 小研把通风柜视窗拉到标示线位置
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lowers the fume hood sash to a marked line on the frame.
shots.narration: 视窗可以上下拉动。

shots.scene: 视窗边框上的标示线和向下箭头
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the sash frame with a marked line and a down arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 操作时开到标示高度，尽量放低。

shots.scene: 通风柜里堆满试剂瓶的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a fume hood crowded with stored reagent bottles, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 通风柜不是储存柜，别堆放化学品。

shots.scene: 小研做完实验把瓶子放回试剂柜，擦干净台面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student returns bottles to a storage cabinet and wipes the empty fume hood work surface.
shots.narration: 做完实验，清理干净，东西拿走。

shots.scene: 洗眼器前堆着纸箱的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of cardboard boxes piled in front of an eyewash station and a fire extinguisher, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 洗眼器、喷淋、灭火器前不准堆东西。

shots.scene: 通往喷淋的通道空空荡荡，绿色箭头直达
shots.prompt_en: A clear path on the floor leads straight to the emergency shower, marked with a green arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 通道畅通，也不能随意挪走设备。

shots.scene: 王老师手持灭火器，身旁四步图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds a dry powder fire extinguisher beside four step icons.
shots.narration: 灭火器使用四步：提、拔、握、压。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在上风处，喷嘴对准火焰根部的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person standing upwind with a clear exit behind, aiming the extinguisher nozzle at the base of a small flame. No people.
shots.narration: 站在上风处，对准火焰根部，留好退路。

shots.scene: 五个火灾类别图标：固体、液体、气体、金属、带电
shots.prompt_en: Five fire type icons in a row: burning wood, burning liquid, a gas cylinder flame, burning metal and a sparking plug. No people.
shots.narration: 国内火灾分类和原片不同，以国标为准。

shots.scene: 手先拉下电闸，再用灭火器的两步图标
shots.prompt_en: Two step icons: a hand switching off a main power switch, then a carbon dioxide extinguisher aimed at an appliance. No people.
shots.narration: 电器着火先断电，别用水和泡沫扑。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着电话图标，旁边是119和120
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a telephone icon next to two blank number cards.
shots.narration: 火警打119，急救打120。

shots.scene: 手按下墙上的手动火灾报警按钮
shots.prompt_en: A hand presses a manual fire alarm button on the corridor wall. No people.
shots.narration: 可就近按下手动火灾报警按钮。

shots.scene: 报告链条：实验室负责人—学院—保卫处
shots.prompt_en: Three linked icons: a lab head, a department building and a campus security office. No people.
shots.narration: 说清地点和情况，同时报告负责人和保卫处。

shots.scene: 人们用湿毛巾捂住口鼻、弯腰沿走廊撤离
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student cover their mouths with wet cloths and walk low along a corridor toward an emergency exit sign.
shots.narration: 撤离时捂住口鼻，低姿走安全出口。

shots.scene: 电梯图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An elevator icon crossed out with a red X next to a staircase icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 走楼梯，不乘电梯，不回头取东西。

shots.scene: 大家在紧急集合点集合，老周清点人数
shots.prompt_en: Students gather at an emergency assembly point sign outdoors while the older man counts heads.
shots.narration: 到集合点集合，清点人数。

shots.scene: 人把头伸进通风柜的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person leaning their head inside a fume hood, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 操作时，头不要伸进通风柜里。

shots.scene: 通风柜报警灯闪烁，小研停下操作、盖好瓶盖
shots.prompt_en: A warning lamp flashes on the fume hood panel; the female graduate student stops work and caps the bottles.
shots.narration: 排风报警或异常，停止实验，报告维修。

shots.scene: 老李逐一检查喷淋、洗眼器、灭火器，在空白卡上打勾
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks the shower, the eyewash station and the fire extinguisher one by one, ticking a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 定期检查测试，保证紧急时件件能用。

shots.scene: 洗眼器和喷淋图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an eyewash station and an emergency shower with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 先找到设备，喷淋冲身，洗眼器冲眼。

shots.scene: 灭火器、灭火毯和119图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fire extinguisher, a fire blanket and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 小火会用灭火器，衣服着火躺倒翻滚。

shots.scene: 疏散路线和集合点图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an evacuation floor plan with two routes and an emergency assembly point sign. No people.
shots.narration: 火大就撤，记住多条疏散路线。

shots.scene: 通风柜视窗放低、排风正常图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fume hood with its sash lowered and an airflow gauge in the green zone. No people.
shots.narration: 通风柜先开排风，不存放化学品。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在安全设备墙前挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in front of the wall with the eyewash station, shower and fire extinguisher.
shots.narration: 认清设备，用对设备，下次见！
